observation_scope: Owner-authorized Jin10 personal latest-page polling and existing moomoo news cache, with actual provider continuity and gaps recorded per source

coverage_states.NO_OBSERVED_NEWS: No article was observed within the defined collection scope while continuity was verified
coverage_states.COLLECTION_GAP: Provider polling, cursor, cache ingestion, or restart continuity is unproven; event count is incomplete
coverage_states.NEUTRAL_TEXT: A scored event exists and its text classification is neutral; it is not absence of news
coverage_states.UNRESOLVED_ASSOCIATION: An article exists but a direct company link is not established

company_snapshot.N1: Equal mean of directly linked source-article text tones within algorithmic event groups, then equal mean of group tones
company_snapshot.N2: Observed source-scoped distinct company event groups; complete count remains null unless source continuity is verified
company_snapshot.availability: max(actual score completion, actual snapshot generation); never earlier than received_at
company_snapshot.article_revisions: Most recent version received and scored by cutoff; prior versions preserved but contribute at most once
company_snapshot.cross_provider_similarity: No verified merger in v4.2; provider groups remain separate

future_labels.target_label_rule: Use the already frozen v4.1 entry/exit and company-action protocol only after prices and horizons mature; this version does not read or create labels

research_limit: No return fit, IC, profitability, or independent forecast claim in v4.2
